summation.displayName: lef (Anthrax LF, lethal factor) a zinc metalloprotease (Klim...
summation.text: lef (Anthrax LF, lethal factor) a zinc metalloprotease (Klimpel et al, 1994) in the target cell cytosol, cleaves MAP2K2 (MEK2, mitogen activated protein kinase kinase 2). While the kinase domain of MAP2K2 is unaffected, an aminoterminal docking domain is disrupted by the cleavage (Duesbery et al. 1998; Vitale et al. 1998).
